enGB: A firearm's capacity is the number of shots it can hold at one time.
zhCN: 火器的载弹量是指其一次能够容纳的弹药发数。

enGB: Scatter (30ft)
zhCN: 散射（30尺）

enGB: Scatter (15ft)
zhCN: 散射（15尺）

enGB: A weapon with the scatter weapon quality can shoot two different types of ammunition. It can fire normal bullets that target one creature, or it can make a scattering shot, attacking all creatures within a cone.  When a scatter weapon attacks all creatures within a cone, it makes a separate attack roll against each creature within the cone. Each attack roll takes a -2 penalty, and its attack damage cannot be modified by precision damage or damage-increasing feats such as Vital Strike. Effects that grant concealment, such as fog or smoke, or the blur, invisibility, or mirror image spells, do not foil a scatter attack.
zhCN: 具有散射武器特性的火器可以发射两种不同类型的弹药。它可以发射对单一生物射击的普通弹丸，也可以进行散射射击，攻击锥形范围内的所有生物。当散射武器攻击锥形范围内的所有生物时，它会对该锥形范围内的每个生物分别进行一次攻击检定。每次攻击检定承受-2减值，且其造成的攻击伤害无法受到精准伤害或增伤专长（如致命一击）的修正。提供隐蔽的效果（如浓雾、烟雾，或虚假视线、隐形术、镜影术等法术）无法阻碍散射攻击。

enGB: Muzzle Loading
zhCN: 前装填

enGB: Early firearms are muzzle-loaded, requiring bullets or pellets and black powder to be rammed down the muzzle.. It is a standard action to load a one-handed early firearm and a full-round action to load a two-handed early firearm.
zhCN: 早期火器为前装填，需要将弹丸或霰弹和黑火药从枪口捣入。装填一把单手早期火器是标准动作，装填一把双手早期火器是整轮动作。

enGB: Chamber Loading
zhCN: 弹仓装填

enGB: Advanced firearms are chamber-loaded. It is a move action to load a one-handed or two-handed advanced firearm to its full capacity. The Rapid Reload feat reduces this to a free action (allowing you to ignore the requirement to reload between shots).
zhCN: 先进火器为弹仓装填。装填一把单手或双手先进火器至满容量是一个移动动作。快速装填专长可将其降为自由动作（使你忽略两次射击间必须装填的要求）。

enGB: Reload
zhCN: 装填

enGB: Rapid Reload
zhCN: 快速装填

enGB: Armor Penetrating
zhCN: 穿甲

enGB: Firearms penetrate most forms of armor: bypassing shield, armor, and natural armor bonuses to AC
zhCN: 火器能穿透大多数类型的盔甲：忽略盾牌、盔甲和天生防御带来的AC加值

enGB: Musket
zhCN: 滑膛枪

enGB: This long-barreled firearm has a much greater range than a pistol. A musket uses either a bullet and 1 dose of black powder or a single alchemical cartridge as its ammunition. This is an early firearm.
zhCN: 这种长管火器比手枪射程远得多。滑膛枪使用一颗子弹和一份黑火药或一枚炼金弹药作为弹药。这是一件早期火器。

enGB: Pistol
zhCN: 手枪

enGB: The basic single-shot pistol is one of the most common firearms, although it is still rare enough to be an object of envy or curiosity to most. This is an early firearm.
zhCN: 基本单发手枪是最常见的火器之一，但仍然罕见，足以成为大多数人羡慕或好奇的对象。这是一件早期火器。

enGB: Shotgun
zhCN: 霰弹枪

enGB: This advanced version of the blunderbuss shoots in a 30-foot cone when firing pellets, and has a 20-foot range increment when firing a bullet (often called a slug). Shotguns can either be simple and functional, or art pieces in their own right, with engravings and inlay on the stocks and breeches. Those used by the upper class are often emblazoned with images of game animals, family crests, or elaborate maker's marks.
zhCN: 这种喇叭枪的先进改良版在装填霰弹发射时呈30尺锥形范围，而在发射单颗重弹（通常称为独头弹）时拥有20尺的基础射程。霰弹枪既可以是朴素实用的工具，也可以是一件真正的艺术品，枪托与枪膛上饰有精美的雕花与镶嵌工艺。上流社会所使用的枪械通常饰有猎兽图案、家族纹章或繁复考究的制作者印记。

enGB: Rifle
zhCN: 步枪

enGB: Mind-Render Rifle
zhCN: 裂脑步枪

enGB: Whenever this +3 keen rifle confirms a critical hit the target suffers an additional 1d6 intelligence damage.
zhCN: 每当这把+3追击步枪确认重击时，目标额外承受1d6点智力伤害。

enGB: Mind-Render
zhCN: 裂脑

enGB: Whenever this weapon confirms a critical hit the target suffers an additional 1d6 intelligence damage.
zhCN: 每当此武器确认重击时，目标额外承受1d6点智力伤害。

enGB: This improvement on the musket features a grooved barrel that imparts a twisting, spiral motion to the bullet as it exits, stabilizing it and preventing the end-over-end tumbling common to projectiles from simpler firearms. As a result, a rifle can fire significantly farther and with more accuracy than early long-bore firearms. A rifle uses metal cartridges as ammunition. This is an advanced firearm.
zhCN: 这种滑膛枪的改进型具有刻有膛线的枪管，能在子弹射出时赋予其旋转、螺旋的运动，稳定弹道并防止简单火器弹药常见的翻滚。因此，步枪的射程和精度远优于早期长管火器。步枪使用金属弹药作为弹药。这是一件先进火器。

enGB: Revolver
zhCN: 转轮枪

enGB: A revolver is a pistol with a revolving cylinder containing six chambers. Each chamber can hold a metal cartridge, and when one cartridge is fired, the cylinder automatically rotates (no extra hand or action required), readying the next chamber for firing. A revolver uses metal cartridges as ammunition. This is an advanced firearm.
zhCN: 转轮枪是一种带有转轮式弹巢的手枪，弹巢内有六个弹仓。每个弹仓可以容纳一发金属弹药，当一发弹药发射后，弹巢会自动旋转（无需额外手部或动作），准备好下一发弹药发射。转轮枪使用金属弹药作为弹药。这是一件先进火器。

enGB: Gunslinger
zhCN: 铳士

enGB:
For a renegade few, battle sounds different than it does for the typical fighter. The clash of steel and the sizzle of spell energy are drowned out by the thunderous rhythm of gunfire: the pounding beat of the gunslinger.

Gunslingers are a bold and mysterious lot. While many treat the secrets of black powder with the same care and reverence that a wizard typically reserves for his spellbook, most gunslingers know that firearms are a secret that cannot remain concealed forever. While current firearms are simple, often imprecise, and even dangerous devices, they are a technology on the move, and one that will become even more powerful when it is fully fused with magic.
zhCN:
对少数叛逆者而言，战斗的声音与普通战士截然不同。刀剑的碰撞声和法术能量的嘶嘶声，被枪火雷鸣般的节奏——铳士那震撼的鼓点——所淹没。

铳士是一群大胆而神秘的家伙。尽管许多人对待黑火药的秘密，如同法师对待法术书一般谨慎而敬畏，但大多数铳士都明白，火器是一个无法永远隐藏的秘密。虽然当前的火器是简单、往往不够精确甚至危险的装置，但它们是一项不断发展的技术，一旦与魔法完全融合，将变得更为强大。

enGB: Gunslinger Proficiencies
zhCN: 铳士擅长

enGB: Gunslingers are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, and with all firearms. They are proficient with all light armor.
zhCN: 铳士擅长所有简易武器、军用武器和所有火器。她们擅长所有轻型盔甲。

enGB: Brave, clever, and frequently foolhardy gunslingers are thunderous artillery, often found where the fighting is fiercest.
zhCN: 勇敢、机敏且常常鲁莽的铳士是雷鸣般的炮手，常出没于战斗最激烈之处。

enGB: Grit
zhCN: 勇毅

enGB:
A gunslinger makes her mark upon the world with daring deeds. Some gunslingers claim they belong to a mystical way of the gun, but it's more likely that the volatile nature of firearms simply prunes the unlucky and careless from their ranks. Whatever the reason, all gunslingers have grit. In game terms, grit is a fluctuating measure of a gunslinger's ability to perform amazing actions in combat. At the start of each day, a gunslinger gains a number of grit points equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Her grit goes up or down throughout the day, but usually cannot go higher than her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), though some feats and magic items may affect this maximum. A gunslinger spends grit to accomplish deeds (see below), and regains grit in the following ways.

Critical Hit with a Firearm: Each time the gunslinger confirms a critical hit with a firearm attack while in the heat of combat, she regains 1 grit point.

Killing Blow with a Firearm: When the gunslinger reduces a creature to 0 or fewer hit points with a firearm attack while in the heat of combat, she regains 1 grit point.
zhCN:
铳士以大胆的炫技在世界上留下自己的印记。有些铳士声称她们属于某种神秘的枪之大道，但更可能的是，火器的不稳定性只会淘汰掉不幸和粗心的人。无论何种原因，所有铳士都拥有勇毅。在游戏术语中，勇毅是一个用来衡量铳士在战斗中完成惊人动作能力的浮动值。每天开始时，铳士获得等于其感知调整值（最低1点）的勇毅值。她的勇毅值会在一天中上下浮动，但通常不能高于她的感知调整值（最低1点），尽管某些专长和魔法物品可能影响此上限。铳士花费勇毅值来执行炫技（见下文），并通过以下方式回复勇毅。

火器造成重击：每次铳士在战斗中用火器攻击确认重击，她回复1点勇毅值。

火器完成击杀：当铳士在战斗中用火器攻击将一个生物的生命值降至0或更低时，她回复1点勇毅值。

enGB: At the start of each day, a gunslinger gains a number of grit points equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Her grit goes up or down throughout the day, but usually cannot go higher than her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1)
zhCN: 每天开始时，铳士获得等于其感知调整值（最低1点）的勇毅值。她的勇毅值会在一天中上下浮动，但通常不能高于她的感知调整值（最低1点）

enGB: Instead of using her Wisdom modifier to determine the number of grit points she gains at the start of each day, she uses her Charisma modifier. This ability works in all other ways like the gunslinger’s grit class feature.
zhCN: 她在每天开始时获得勇毅值的数量改为由其魅力调整值决定，而非感知调整值。在其他所有方面，此能力运作方式皆与铳士的勇毅职业特性相同。

enGB: At the start of each day, a gunslinger gains a number of grit points equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Her grit goes up or down throughout the day, but usually cannot go higher than her Charisma modifier (minimum 1)
zhCN: 每天开始时，铳士获得等于其魅力调整值（最低1点）的勇毅值。她的勇毅值会在一天中上下浮动，但通常不能高于她的魅力调整值（最低1点）

enGB: True Grit
zhCN: 纯正勇毅

enGB: At 20th level, a gunslinger recoveres 1 grit each time she spends it allowing her to perform deeds for 1 grit less so long as she has enough grit to perform them at their standard cost.
zhCN: 20级时，铳士每次花费勇毅值时回复1点，这使她只要拥有足以支付炫技标准消耗的勇毅值，就可以以少花费1点勇毅的代价执行炫技。

enGB: Gun Training
zhCN: 枪械训练

enGB: Starting at 5th level, a gunslinger gains a bonus equal to her Dexterity modifier on damage rolls with firearms.
zhCN: 从5级开始，铳士在火器的伤害检定上获得等于其敏捷调整值的加值。

enGB: Nimble
zhCN: 机敏

enGB: Starting at 2nd level, a gunslinger gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light or no armor. Anything that causes the gunslinger to lose her Dexterity bonus to AC also causes the gunslinger to lose this dodge bonus. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd level (to a maximum of +5 at 20th level).
zhCN: 从2级开始，铳士在穿戴轻型盔甲或无甲时，AC获得+1闪避加值。任何导致铳士失去AC敏捷加值的情况也会使她失去此闪避加值。此加值在2级后每4级额外+1（20级时达到最大+5）。

enGB: AC Bonus (Nimble)
zhCN: AC加值（机敏）

enGB: Seadog's Gait
zhCN: 老水手步法

enGB: At 1st level, the buccaneer gains a +2 bonus on mobility checks. If she spends 1 grit point, she can ignore difficult terrain until the end of her turn. This replaces the quick clear deed.
zhCN: 1级时，海盗在机动检定上获得+2加值。若她花费1点勇毅值，则可以在其回合结束前忽略困难地形。此能力取代快速清膛炫技。

enGB: Spend 1 grit point, to ignore difficult terrain until the end of your turn
zhCN: 花费1点勇毅值，在其回合结束前忽略困难地形

enGB: Pirate’s Jargon
zhCN: 海盗行话

enGB: At 3rd level, the buccaneer’s baffling palaver of nautical jargon and piratical cant provides a +2 bonus on Bluff and Intimidate checks. Furthermore, she can spend a swift action and 1 grit point to cause a single living creature within 30 feet to make a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 her buccaneer level + her Charisma modifier) or become confused for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting language-dependent effect.
zhCN: 3级时，海盗口中那套令人摸不着头脑的航海术语与海盗黑话使其在欺骗和威吓检定上获得+2加值。此外，她可以用一个迅捷动作并花费1点勇毅值，使30尺内的一个活物进行一次意志豁免（DC = 10 + 1/2海盗等级 + 她的魅力调整值），若未通过则困惑1轮。此为影响心灵且依赖语言的效果。

enGB: Spend a swift action and 1 grit point to cause a single living creature within 30 feet to make a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 her buccaneer level + her Charisma modifier) or become confused for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting language-dependent effect.
zhCN: 以迅捷动作花费1点勇毅值，使30尺内的一个活物进行一次意志豁免（DC = 10 + 1/2海盗等级 + 她的魅力调整值），若未通过则困惑1轮。此为影响心灵且依赖语言的效果。

enGB: Liquid Courage
zhCN: 借酒壮胆

enGB: At 2nd level, a buccaneer gains the ability to fortify her grit with strong drink. The act of drinking is a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity, and each drink provides 1 grog point. Grog points can be used in place of grit points to fuel deeds or grit feats (including those requiring a minimum of 1 grit point to use). The buccaneer can gain a maximum number of grog points each day equal to her Constitution modifier (minimum 1), and they last for 1 hour or until used, whichever comes first. She gains a morale bonus on saves against fear and a dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity equal to her current grog point total. This ability replaces the nimble ability.
zhCN: 2级时，海盗获得了饮用烈酒来激发勇毅的能力。饮酒是一个会引发借机攻击的标准动作，每喝一次便获得1点烈酒点。烈酒点可代替勇毅点用于驱动炫技或勇毅专长（包括那些需要至少拥有1点勇毅值才能使用的能力）。海盗每天可获得的烈酒点上限等于其体质调整值（最低1点），持续1小时或直至消耗完毕，以先到者为准。她在对抗恐惧的豁免检定上获得士气加值，并在对抗借机攻击时获得AC闪避加值，数值等于其当前拥有的烈酒点总数。此能力取代机敏能力。

enGB: Grog
zhCN: 烈酒

enGB: Buccaneer
zhCN: 海盗

enGB: Freebooters who cling to the convoluted codes that rule independent ships, the buccaneer is a gunslinger of the high seas. Their exploits are fueled by the thrill of danger and often by the temporary courage provided by grog.
zhCN: 作为信奉独立船只间繁复戒律的亡命之徒，海盗乃是大洋之上的铳士。惊心动魄的危险滋养着他们的壮举，而劣酒所带来的短暂勇气更屡屡为其推波助澜。

enGB: Warp Space
zhCN: 扭曲空间

enGB: Gateways between planes can warp the space around them interfering with normal teleportation yet to one with true understanding that distorted space can allow for a whole other kind of transport. This ability can be used at will and functions as dimension door however it can only be used while under the effects of Tear Proximity.
zhCN: 位面之间的通道会扭曲周遭的空间并干扰常规的传送术，但对真正掌握其精妙之人而言，这种扭曲的空间反倒能实现某种全然不同的位移方式。此能力可随意使用，效果如同任意门，但唯有处于“临近裂隙”状态下时方可施展。

enGB: This ability can be used at will and functions as dimension door however it can only be used while under the effects of Tear Proximity.
zhCN: 此能力可随意使用，效果如同任意门，但唯有处于“临近裂隙”状态下时方可施展。

enGB: Finnean the Talking Weapon
zhCN: 话痨武器芬恩

enGB: Finnean
zhCN: 芬恩

enGB: This weapon was once the seat of Finnean's soul. Now that the soul of the Sarkorian Pathfinder has left the weapon, it has fallen silent forever.
zhCN: 这把武器曾是芬恩灵魂的居所。如今，萨克里斯探索者的灵魂已离它而去，武器陷入了永恒的沉寂。

enGB: Aberrant Bile
zhCN: 异化胆汁

enGB: Aberrant bile has  worked its way into your lungs. Dealing 2 inteligence damage once per hour requires 3 successful fortitude saves to cure.
zhCN: 异化胆汁渗入了你的肺部。每小时造成2点智力伤害，需要成功通过3次强韧豁免方可治愈。

enGB: Leave
zhCN: 离开

enGB: Continue.
zhCN: 继续。

enGB: Spellscar Drifter
zhCN: 法痕流浪者

enGB: The Spellscar Desert is a dangerous wasteland into which few venture without a guide. Spellscar drifters have made themselves at home in these badlands. When not scouring the desert for forgotten treasures or magic hidden by the region's shifting magic-dead zones, a Spellscar drifter might hire himself out as a guide, bodyguard, or assassin. There are even a few Spellscar drifters who are temporarily deputized by the Grand Duchy of Alkenstar to perform law enforcement tasks beyond the reach of the city's normal constabulary. Spellscar drifters are self-reliant and always keep their firearms loaded in the Spellscar Desert, a rider with a slow draw doesn't live long.
zhCN: 法痕荒漠是一片危机四伏的废土，鲜有人敢在没有向导的情况下涉足其中。法痕流浪者却在这片不毛之地如鱼得水。当不在荒漠中搜寻被遗忘的宝藏，或是发掘被当地游移不定的死魔法区所掩埋的秘法时，法痕流浪者也会受雇充当向导、保镖或刺客。甚至有少数法痕流浪者会接受阿尔肯星大公国的临时委派，去执行城中寻常警备队力所不及的执法任务。法痕流浪者凡事皆靠自己，在法痕荒漠中枪械永远处于装填就绪的状态——毕竟拔枪慢半拍的枪手可活不长久。

enGB: Spellscar drifters are self-reliant and always keep their firearms loaded in the Spellscar Desert, a rider with a slow draw doesn't live long.
zhCN: 法痕流浪者凡事皆靠自己，在法痕荒漠中枪械永远处于装填就绪的状态——毕竟拔枪慢半拍的枪手可活不长久。

enGB: Tough As Nails
zhCN: 坚毅硬汉

enGB: At 20th level, if the Spellscar drifter confirms a critical hit on an attack made with a firearm, the target is stunned for 1d4 rounds. A successful Will saving throw (DC = 10 + the Spellscar drifter's base attack bonus) reduces this effect to staggered instead of stunned
zhCN: 20级起，若法痕流浪者使用火器发动的攻击确认重击，目标将震慑1d4轮。成功的意志豁免（DC = 10 + 法痕流浪者的基本攻击加值）可将该效果减轻为恍惚而非震慑。

enGB: The Spellscar drifter can stun or stagger an enemy on a critical hit with a firearm.
zhCN: 法痕流浪者在使用火器造成重击时，可令敌人陷入震慑或恍惚。

enGB: Spell Severed
zhCN: 魔力断绝

enGB: At 12th level, a Spellscar drifter becomes permanently marked by long exposure to the Spellscar Desert. The Spellscar drifter gains spell resistance equal to 10 + her character level.
zhCN: 12级起，长年累月暴露在法痕荒漠的环境中，使法痕流浪者留下了永久的异质烙印。法痕流浪者获得等于10 + 其角色等级的法术抗力。

enGB: The Spellscar drifter gains spell resistance equal to 10 + her character level.
zhCN: 法痕流浪者获得等于10 + 其角色等级的法术抗力。

enGB: Old Reliable
zhCN: 忠实老伙计

enGB: At 11th level, whenever a Spellscar drifter declares a challenge, the threat range of the Spellscar drifter's firearm is doubled against the target of her challenge. This increase does not stack with other effects that double the threat range of the weapon.
zhCN: 11级起，每当法痕流浪者发起挑战时，其持用的火器针对其挑战目标的威胁范围翻倍。此增幅不与其它使武器威胁范围翻倍的效果叠加。

enGB: The threat range of the Spellscar drifter's firearms is doubled against the target of her challenge.
zhCN: 法痕流浪者针对其挑战目标时，其火器的威胁范围翻倍。

enGB: Order of the Eastern Star
zhCN: 东方之星骑士团

enGB: This cavalier order exists to keep dangerous secrets hidden from the world and secretly protect the world against unimaginable threats from beyond the mortal realms. These cavaliers scout and observe, concerning themselves not with the trivial pursuit of morality, but rather with ensuring the survival of society itself. Edicts: The cavalier must preserve the secrets of his order while acting to protect civilization against occult threats. He must thwart the schemes of otherworldly horrors and must give his order a full accounting of any potential threats.
zhCN: 该骑士团的存在旨在将凶险的秘辛深埋于世，并暗中庇御这方天地免遭来自凡俗界域之外不可名状的恐怖侵害。这些骑士充当斥候并密切监视，从不将心思耗费在繁文缛节的道德教条上，而是矢志确保整个人类社会得以存续。教条：骑士必须恪守其骑士团的机密，同时奋身庇护文明免遭神秘异象的威胁。他必须挫败异界可怖存在的阴谋，并向其所属的骑士团巨细靡遗地汇报任何潜在隐患。

enGB: Challenge
zhCN: 挑战

enGB: Whenever a cavalier of the order of the eastern star issues a challenge, she receives a +1 dodge bonus to AC and a +1 insight bonus on saves against the attacks and abilities of the target of his challenge. She must be wearing light armor or no armor to receive these bonuses. These bonuses increase by 1 for every 4 class levels the cavalier possesses.
zhCN: 每当东方之星骑士团的骑士发起挑战时，在对抗其挑战目标的攻击与能力时，其AC获得+1闪避加值，豁免检定获得+1洞察加值。她必须穿戴轻型盔甲或无甲才能获得这些加值。骑士每拥有4个职业等级，这些加值便再提升1点。

enGB: Skills
zhCN: 技能

enGB: A cavalier belonging to the order of the eastern star adds Knowledge (arcana) to her class skills. She receives a bonus on Knowledge (arcana) checks equal to 1/2 his cavalier level (minimum +1).
zhCN: 隶属于东方之星骑士团的骑士将知识（神秘）加入其本职技能。她在知识（神秘）检定上获得等于其骑士等级一半的加值（最低+1）。

enGB: Guarded
zhCN: 戒备体势

enGB: At 2nd level, the cavalier gains DR 1/- and a +2 morale bonus on saving throws when wearing light armor or no armor and fighting defensively or using Combat Expertise. At 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this DR increases by 1.
zhCN: 2级起，当穿戴轻型盔甲或无甲，且处于全防御或使用战斗专长防御姿态时，骑士获得DR 1/-，并在豁免检定上获得+2士气加值。在6级以及之后每提升4级，此DR均额外提升1点。

enGB: Pierce the Guard
zhCN: 破防之刺

enGB: At 8th level, the cavalier's weapons are treated as having the cavalier's {g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}alignment{/g} for the purpose of overcoming the {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}damage reduction{/g} of extraplaner creatures. Against an extraplaner target of her challenge, the cavalier automatically overcomes all damage reduction that creature possesses.
zhCN: 8级起，在克服异界生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}时，骑士的武器视同具备骑士自身的{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}阵营{/g}属性。对抗其挑战的异界目标时，骑士自动穿透该生物拥有的所有伤害减免。

enGB: One Purpose
zhCN: 戮力同心

enGB: At 15th level, the cavalier's mount shares the benefits of the cavalier's guarded ability. The cavalier must fight defensively or use Combat Expertise to grant these benefits, but the mount need not. In addition, the mount gains all the benefits of the cavalier's challenge.
zhCN: 15级起，骑士的坐骑可共享骑士“戒备体势”能力带来的增益。骑士必须处于全防御或使用战斗专长防御姿态方可赋予这些增益，但坐骑本身无需如此。此外，坐骑还能获得骑士“挑战”能力带来的全部益处。
